title: Fast and Accurate Dual-Way Streaming PARAFAC2 for Irregular Tensors - Algorithm and Application

problem.claim: Efficient and accurate analysis is needed for irregular tensors in a dual-way streaming setting where two tensor dimensions grow over time.

gap.claim: Static PARAFAC2 methods are inefficient for dual-way streaming because they repeatedly decompose accumulated tensors, while existing streaming methods have limited applicability and do not efficiently handle new matrix rows.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper frames efficient and accurate dual-way streaming analysis of irregular tensors as the central question.
Irregular tensors consist of matrices with equal column lengths and differing row lengths; dual-way streaming adds rows to existing matrices and adds new matrices over time.
PARAFAC2 decomposition is presented as an important tool for analyzing irregular tensors.
Static and existing streaming PARAFAC2 methods are described as inadequate for efficient dual-way streaming analysis.

unknowns: The abstract units do not identify a proposed algorithm or its technical mechanism.
No experimental setup, quantitative results, anomaly taxonomy, or application details are supplied.
